payload.thinking:
The excerpt always tacks on an ellipsis, even when the text already fits, which is the main bug. The boundary check is also off by one: slicing to the limit leaves out the character at that index, so a word that ends exactly at the limit gets dropped. With 'one two three' and a limit of 7, it returns 'one' when 'one two' would fit. The test asserts that wrong result, so it locks the bug in.

I'm checking the rest of the excerpt logic: hard cuts with no space and the toPlain stripping, which seems to mangle snake_case and miss heading and image markup. The link regex runs after the markers are stripped, so that part looks fine. I'll run the tests to confirm.

payload.text:
I wouldn't merge `excerpt-helper` yet: it has one blocking bug and one off-by-one. The tests pass, but they only check the happy path, so they don't catch either problem. I didn't change anything on the branch.

**Blocking**
1. **Every card gets an ellipsis, even when nothing was cut.** `excerpt()` always adds `…`. The README says short text comes back unchanged and the ellipsis only appears when text was removed, but the code never checks the length. When I ran it, `excerpt('short', 50)` gave `"short…"` and `excerpt('', 5)` gave `"…"`. So every short card body and every empty one would show a stray ellipsis. It needs an early `if (trimmed.length <= limit) return trimmed;`.

**Should fix**
2. **A word that ends exactly at the limit gets dropped.** `lastSpaceBefore` only searches the first `limit` characters, so it never sees a space sitting right at the limit. `excerpt('one two three', 7)` gives `"one…"` when `"one two"` fits exactly. The README promises a cut "at or before the limit," so the search needs to include position `limit` (e.g. `text.slice(0, limit + 1)`). The test in `words.test.js` expects `3` here, so it currently locks in the bug and would need updating too.

**Minor (`toPlain`)**
3. **Underscores, asterisks and backticks are removed everywhere, not just as formatting.** `my_var_name` becomes `myvarname`, and code or math in card bodies would get mangled the same way.
4. **Headings and images aren't handled.** `# Title` keeps its `#`, and `![img](u)` becomes `!img`. Fine to defer if your cards don't use them, but the README says markers are removed.

**Tests worth adding:** text shorter than the limit, text exactly at the limit, empty text, and a word ending exactly at the limit.

The version bump to 1.5.0, the CHANGELOG entry and the README read fine. One small thing: the CHANGELOG also edits the existing 1.4.0 line ("a title and body"). It's harmless, but you may not want to touch past entries.
